page_title: STR 0-1 LEN | Strasbourg v Lens 29/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' Jerome Brisard is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.

90+3' Adrien Thomasson (Lens) produces a stunning solo run from the middle of the pitch, all the way to the penalty area. He unleashes a decent strike which goes narrowly wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Strasbourg will have a goal kick.
90+3' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Strasbourg.

90+2' The linesman points to the corner flag, Strasbourg are going to take it. Lucas Perrin (Strasbourg) rises above the defenders and places a towering header towards the left post, but Brice Samba is prepared and dives to thwart him.
90+1' It's like he was asking for a caution. Neil El Aynaoui (Lens) receives a yellow card.
90+1' Lens enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
90+1' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
87' Ibrahima Sissoko (Strasbourg) commits a rough foul. Jerome Brisard stops the game and makes a call.
85' Franck Haise has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Neil El Aynaoui (Lens) replacing Andy Diouf.
83' It looks like Ibrahima Sissoko (Strasbourg) saw red with that tackle. Jerome Brisard won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
82' Andy Diouf (Lens) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
81' Substitution. Ibrahima Sissoko (Strasbourg) in, Habib Diarra out.

81' Adrien Thomasson (Lens) came close to scoring but should have done much better. His poor attempt from close range ended up in the gloves of Matz Sels. The ball goes out of play and Lens have been awarded a corner kick.
80' Andy Diouf (Lens) takes the corner which is cleared. Lens have been awarded a corner kick.
80' Great teamplay by Lens as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
78' Kevin Gameiro (Strasbourg) goes for goal, but his effort isn't precise at all and it flies yards wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Lens will have a goal kick.
77' Dangerous play by Angelo (Strasbourg). Jerome Brisard blows his whistle for a foul.
75' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Deiver Machado trots off the pitch and is replaced by Przemyslaw Frankowski (Lens).
75' Franck Haise decides to make a substitution. Angelo Fulgini will be replaced by Adrien Thomasson (Lens).
73' 5:3 – the total goal attempt statistics.
72' Lens control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
70' We are about to witness a subsitution. Lebo Mothiba (Strasbourg) for Emanuel Emegha.
69' What was Ismael Doukoure (Strasbourg) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
66' Here is a change. Elye Wahi is going off and Franck Haise gives the last tactical orders to Morgan Guilavogui (Lens).
66' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Salis Abdul Samed (Lens) comes onto the pitch for Nampalys Mendy.
64' Rough tackle by Marvin Senaya (Strasbourg). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
63' Emanuel Emegha (Strasbourg) attempts to discuss the decision with Jerome Brisard, but he soon realises that it's not the right thing to do as he sees the yellow.

61' Gerzino Nyamsi (Strasbourg) reacts well and displays good awareness inside the box to get on the end of the resulting corner kick. He fails to direct the ball into the net as it flies narrowly over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lens.
61' Patrick Vieira has decided to substitute Jessy Deminguet and he is replaced by Moise Sahi Dion (Strasbourg).
61' Substitution. Kevin Gameiro (Strasbourg) has come on for Dilane Bakwa.
60' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) prepares to take a corner kick.
59' Andy Diouf (Lens) takes the corner but it's cleared.
58' Deiver Machado (Lens) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety. The ball goes out for a corner. Lens can continue in their attacking effort.
54' Jerome Brisard shows a yellow card to Nampalys Mendy (Lens) for his blatant foul.
50' Elye Wahi (Lens) is unlucky with a low drive from the edge of the box. A decent save by Matz Sels stops the ball from hitting the middle of the net.
48' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Lens.
46' Jerome Brisard blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+6' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' Facundo Medina (Lens) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
45' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
44' Marvin Senaya (Strasbourg) is able to continue to play.
42' Marvin Senaya (Strasbourg) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
41' Shots on target – 1:1.
40' Jessy Deminguet (Strasbourg) shows too much aggression while trying to break free from his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
39' Marvin Senaya (Strasbourg) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
38' Marvin Senaya (Strasbourg) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
38' Jerome Brisard blows his whistle. Andy Diouf (Lens) commits a foul after dangerous play.
35' Neat passing move from Strasbourg in order to create new attacking opportunities.
35' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
34' The game is interrupted now, Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
33' Jonathan Gradit (Lens) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Jerome Brisard had an easy-decision to make.

29' Florian Sotoca (Lens) sprints into the box to get on the end of a cross and directs a shot goalwards that flies a whisker wide of the right post. Unlucky! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Strasbourg.
25' Angelo (Strasbourg) is penalised for holding. Jerome Brisard signals a set piece.
22' The Lens players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
21' Kevin Danso (Lens) finds himself behind the opposition's defence, but the game is stopped for offside.
20' Ismael Doukoure (Strasbourg) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle.

16' 0 - 1 Goal! Elye Wahi (Lens) weaves his way past opponents, and he unleashes a magnificent effort from the edge of the box inside the left post. Matz Sels had no chance of reaching it. The score is 0:1.
16' Deiver Machado (Lens) commits a foul and Jerome Brisard immediately signals a free kick.
12' Habib Diarra (Strasbourg) finds space inside the box but rifles his effort miles past the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lens.
10' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the bottom right corner, but Brice Samba easily deals with the threat.
8' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) unleashes a shot towards the goal, but his effort isn't precise at all and it flies high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Lens will have a goal kick.
4' Ruben Aguilar (Lens) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Strasbourg.
3' Lens are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out at last! Lens will take the kick-off.
